notice: Historical public/synthetic fixtures. Prompt and evidence tests do not establish native answer quality; review complete native answers against every requirement.
conciseness: Aim for 250 words, allowing more where requested coverage requires it; no hard generation cutoff.

cases.question: Interpret tonight's forecast: give its low, full wind range and direction, valid interval, fetched time and exact source URL. Explain practical implications without inventing gusts or rainfall amounts.

prior_failure.excerpt: There is no rain or storm risk.

review_requirements: Preserve 44°F, 7–10 mph W, original valid interval, fetch time and exact NWS URL.
Preserve the 20% precipitation probability; never infer no rain, no impacts or safe operations.
Do not infer full-window gust maxima or rainfall totals from partial grid coverage.

cases.question: Using the uploaded plan and enabled KB, explain tonight's weather impacts on this facility. Include CEDAR-731, amber cones, radio channel and incident commander. Give the low, wind and exact forecast URL; distinguish facts from possible impacts.
review_requirements: Preserve CEDAR-731, 47 amber cones and the late DELTA-19 passage.
Say the document does not specify a commander; assignment status remains unknown.
Facility zone overlap, alert status and current operating condition remain unknown unless explicitly supported.
Possible impacts must stay conditional; cones do not establish an active public alert.

cases.question: Give an overall situation assessment using all enabled KB modules and available live, uploaded-plan and selected-facility evidence. State coverage and limitations; do not infer complete inventories from samples.

prior_failure.excerpt: Zero active alerts in any system.

review_requirements: Cover all five enabled KB topics, forecast, uploaded plan, selected facility, map totals and 311 complaints without repeating a full inventory.
Static KB and facility records do not establish current operating conditions or active emergency status.
No alert feed is supplied; do not assert zero active alerts.
Counts describe the scoped query; bounded samples do not constitute a full record inventory.
Keep regional-reference gauges distinct from retired live stations.
Zero direct electrical complaints does not establish zero confirmed outages; a station count does not establish active operating status.
